cells.items: Path converters int/string/slug/UUID/path; regex; Include; namespace; Reverse/Resolve; script prefix; language-prefix routes

cells.rule: Proxy-derived values trusted only from configured CIDRs; bodies bounded and parsed once; per-request values not global.

cells.rule: Validate redirect targets/header values; headers immutable after first write; safe error envelope.

cells.rule: Enter configured order; unwind reverse order; exception after stream begins closes stream, cannot replace status.

cells.rule: Request compression opt-in for sensitive dynamic bodies; authentication before permissions; cache keys include full Vary scope.
